cards.card_text: When the master comes, he cuts that servant to pieces and assigns him a place with the unbelievers.
cards.verse_text: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
cards.snippet: …will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.

cards.verse_text: Pray that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in Judea, and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there,
cards.snippet: Pray that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in Judea, and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to…

cards.verse_text: Instead, one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!
cards.snippet: …one brother goes to law against another, and this in front of unbelievers!

cards.card_text: Next scene: an unbeliever invites a believer to a meal, and the believer wants to go.
cards.verse_text: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
cards.snippet: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything…

cards.card_text: Then Paul says tongues are a sign for believers, not for unbelievers.
cards.verse_text: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers.
cards.snippet: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers.

cards.card_text: Now he paints a picture where the whole church comes together, everyone speaks in tongues, and in walk some uninstructed people or unbelievers.
cards.verse_text: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers.
cards.snippet: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers.

cards.card_text: But flip it: everyone's prophesying, and an unbeliever or uninstructed person walks in.
cards.verse_text: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all, and the secrets of his heart will be made known.
cards.snippet: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be…

cards.card_text: Then Paul says the god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers.
cards.verse_text: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
cards.snippet: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory…

cards.card_text: Paul says the god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers.
cards.verse_text: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.
cards.snippet: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory…

cards.card_text: Now he gives them a command: "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers."
cards.verse_text: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers.
cards.snippet: Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers.

cards.card_text: Paul keeps the questions coming: what harmony is there between Christ and Belial, and what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
cards.verse_text: Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?
cards.snippet: Or what does a believer have in common with an unbeliever?

cards.card_text: Paul also says anyone who does not provide for his own household is worse than an unbeliever.
cards.verse_text: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
cards.snippet: …own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
